description: Project 903 Lun missile-carrying ekranoplan, the only one built; completed at Gorky in December 1989, accepted for trials service that month and formally taken into the Soviet Navy in 1991. Beached at Derbent in July 2020 after being towed from Kaspiysk to become the centrepiece of the planned Patriot Park. Hull only - the six Moskit launchers and most equipment are absent.
